demo.reason: The core Lite value is a readable 12-hour forecast timeline; a static real forecast state communicates it faster than a mandatory video.

features.title: See the rest of your day.
features.subtitle: A 12-hour forecast ribbon makes the next weather change obvious at a glance.
items: NOW, hourly conditions, temperature, rain chance, and day/night shading live in one continuous view.
Solar events sit on the timeline where they actually happen instead of becoming separate cards.
If a refresh fails, the last successful forecast stays visible with a clear stale state.
Location, automatic units, refresh cadence, and theme stay in iCUE settings.

showcase.title: Weather makes more sense in time.
showcase.subtitle: Temperature, conditions, rain chance, and the NOW marker use the full width of the display.

settings.title: Four useful weather looks.
settings.subtitle: The same timeline stays readable across normal, rain, and night states.

sizes.title: Forecasts built for the slot.
sizes.subtitle: Horizontal layouts stretch the timeline; vertical layouts reflow it instead of shrinking the same screen.
sizes.footer: 8 tuned layouts   •   S, M, L + XL   •   horizontal + vertical
